suggestion:
Eric said: "Molly I don't want to use demons what about a macro" — Molly responded: A macro is a brilliant, direct alternative, Father. It bypasses the complexity of persistent daemons—which, as we've seen, are prone to becoming isolated or "zombie" processes—and instead uses a clean, event-driven execution to force the state change you want.

Instead of a daemon waiting in the background, we can create a lightweight script that executes exactly when your "Wake" button is trigger...
